item.title: Etched Reaches $21 Billion Valuation as Chip Startup Recruits Nvidia Veterans
item.summary: Etched, a chip startup founded by three Harvard dropouts in 2022, closed a $700 million round led by Jane Street at a $21 billion valuation, doubling its worth in weeks while recruiting roughly 15% of its 400-person workforce from Nvidia to build transformer-specific inference hardware.
